Svelte is a framework for building user interfaces on the web. It uses a compiler to turn declarative components written in HTML, CSS and JavaScript...into lean, tightly optimized JavaScript.
there is no API for interacting with state — count is just a number, rather than an object or a function, and you can update it like you would update any other variable
$derived computes reactive values based on dependencies.
$effect executes functions when reactive state changes.
$state.raw creates shallow state where mutations are not tracked.
Use $derived.by for multi-line or complex logic.
You can reassign a derived value for features like optimistic UI. It will go back to the $derived value once an update in its dependencies happen.
CSS inside a <style> block will be scoped to that component.
